scope: Sanitized implementation and bounded host evidence for shared provider execution; not an installed/live Plugin checkpoint.

A.evidence_role: bounded public-API host probe plus one parameterized launch factory
facts: Official Chrome 152.0.7977.84 launched with Playwright 1.60.0 and a managed empty profile.
The Chrome case remained launchable with invalid Camoufox-only environment values and did not use Camoufox fallback materials.

B.evidence_role: bounded real-browser file/guard probe on a controlled origin
facts: PNG and ordinary same-page CSV transfer completed with stable hashes: png_sha256=696174f1d5b4a78320dcfeb82329a4f263b8fa86b3d1fdb127fe0e062394f725; csv_sha256=b83210619895382e6503972f12227777bc74d63fc203775e8b2bda84374fc8c1.
Direct and redirect guard checks recorded zero unauthorized-origin hits.

C.evidence_role: bounded real-browser delayed-event probe and #526 continuity-shaped check
facts: A delayed event was observed after 10.5 seconds without an intervening read/snapshot; the silent 10.005-second check recorded work=1 and completion=1.

counterexamples.case: Chromium anchor with HTML download attribute
counterexamples.evidence_role: real Chromium observation plus deterministic regression
counterexamples.reason: Chromium emitted Download but no Page request/route chain; the event is not sufficient to claim a managed file and no staging is committed.
continue_ dispatched the unauthorized /private hop; the guarded implementation uses route.fetch(max_redirects=0) before dispatch and validates every hop.

evidence_roles.source_and_assets: relative packaged-source paths and SHA-256 values above; no temporary profile or payload is retained
evidence_roles.deterministic: parameterized Harbor launch/trust tests and strict installed-runtime pairing tests
evidence_roles.host_probe: bounded macOS Chrome probe; host-specific evidence only
evidence_roles.plugin: not run; no installed/live Agent completion is claimed

limits: G0 results do not establish the full owner/control/Plugin checkpoint or release support.
Chrome evidence covers a managed empty profile and ordinary same-page HTTP(S) attachment; the download-attribute relation remains intentionally unsupported.
The shared pairing must remain owner-verified at installation time; missing, mismatched, or untrusted runtime facts are unavailable rather than a late driver failure.
